title: Super Egg Drop
goal: Find the fewest worst-case egg drops needed to identify the critical floor.
strategy: Invert the usual question: with a fixed number of moves and eggs, count how many floors can be resolved. One drop covers lower floors when the egg breaks, upper floors when it survives, and the tested floor itself.
